author: Akien
prose: here's what i think. i think we need a new category. we have devices... big things. there's often only one of each one. but then we have TOOLS. A tool is an INSPECTOR, a LEARNING BLOCK, a GATE, a Mesh/Nest/Seive... these are things we use all over the place. Maybe there needs to be a folder of tools or helpers as part of this untangling
